positions.title: App Developer
description: Developed a production-ready Flutter mobile application for the company's Real Time Data Acquisition System (RTDAS) used for live dam monitoring, implementing a modular architecture with reusable widgets and a dedicated API service layer
Migrated the backend from Node.js + Microsoft SQL Server to a PHP + MySQL REST API, converting database queries and endpoints while maintaining compatibility with the existing dashboard functionality

Implemented secure authentication, live station monitoring, interactive maps using flutter_map, real-time telemetry dashboards, and Syncfusion gauges/charts with Historical, Daily, and Last 7 Days reporting
Integrated REST APIs, optimized JSON parsing and state management, resolved data inconsistencies between web and mobile dashboards, and generated Android release builds for internal deployment

positions.title: Full Stack Intern
description: Built a full-stack TV e-commerce platform using the MERN stack, featuring a product catalog, shopping cart with discount code support, and a password-protected admin dashboard with full CRUD operations via MongoDB

Developed a devotee management web application for ISKCON Kolhapur with React.js and Express.js, implementing JWT-based authentication, admin user controls, a darshan gallery, Ekadashi calendar, and a devotional bookstore with live cart functionality
Progressed through the full stack independently — from plain HTML/CSS/JS and Bootstrap to React.js, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB — delivering two client-facing production projects

positions.title: Freelance React Native Developer
description: Designed the skeletal architecture of a cross-platform mobile app using React Native, covering theming system, colorful UI component structure, and screen navigation layout
Built a dynamic theming system allowing instant, app-wide theme switching applied across buttons and screens on a single tap
Scaffolded PDF/Excel data export and Stripe payment integration touchpoints, along with backend API connectivity
